children: Veraxa Biotech named Raju Willener as its chief financial officer, effective immediately.
Willener succeeds Carl von Halem, who was serving as interim chief financial officer after Torsten Burgermeister stepped down in July. Burgermeister had been in the role since 2022.
Willener brings more than 30 years of financial leadership in finances and across the biopharmaceutical industry, the Swiss biotechnology company said Friday.
Most recently, he served as director of corporate development at Exentis Group before being appointed chief financial officer in 2025.
